notes: 'as for' is added under rule 16 (fronted phrase with no marker or fronting לְ); 'such as' is the substantival article's under rule 41.

'unto' stays with the transitive hiphil that governs עֲקַלְקַלּוֹת as bare object (rules 33, 44); 'forth' kept with הוֹלִיךְ as its phrasal rendering, with the surplus-particle reading named as the competing one.
